summary: An LTP subscription on an NSE equity: Pocketful's 42-byte compact packet becomes an LTP frame; a fall decodes as a signed change; a packet cut short reaches nobody, nor does one after the unsubscribe.

notes: Frames hand-built from the decoder's offsets (packet_decoder.py:252-265); the web publishes the compact packet on the subscription's LTP topic (pocketful_adapter.py:631-642).

deviations.reason: Pocketful sends the last trade time in epoch seconds and the web passes the seconds on as ltt; the desktop sends epoch milliseconds, the unit the docs give every WebSocket time (decisions 2026-11-09: ltt in seconds -> ms, a web defect, wrong unit).

The compact packet's change is a signed number; the web unpacks it unsigned (packet_decoder.py:257, '>I'), so a fall of 10.50 becomes 42949662.46. The desktop reads it signed (audit RB-14; lead ruling 2026-11-09: keep the desktop's).
